text: Amination is called by Mr Kirwan in the muriatic geum of earth, breatls it contains about a fifth part of magnifica. Its other enthusiasts are, film, mid calcareous earth, bayres, clay, and a very final pro portion of iron. It is fullible _per f in a first long,_ but, and allo with the common fluxes. It differs from afbele in containing force prodorous art.
